_notes: 1. Ps 118(119):89 'In ætérnum, Dómine, pérmanet verbum tuum' — 思高 v.89 reads '上主，你的圣言，存留永远，它坚固而不移，好似苍天'; antiphon abbreviated to 'In ætérnum… pérmanet verbum tuum'; rendered structurally with mediant splitting the 思高 text. 2. Ps 118(119):90 'véritas tua' rendered as '你所有的忠诚，代代流传' (思高 wording); antiphon shortens to in sæculum sæculi. 3. Ps 118(119):36-37 'Inclína cor meum… in testimónia tua / Avérte óculos meos…' — 思高 uses '律例' for testimony/statutes, but the breviary pairs 'testimonia' twice; rendered as '训诫' (liturgical form, not strictly 律例/约法). 4. Ps 91(90):3 'de láqueo venántium' — breviary uses first person ('liberávit me') vs. 思高 second person ('救你'); adapted to first person 'de láqueo venántium' → '脱离猎户的缧絏' following 思高 vocabulary. 5. Ps 91(90):4 'Scápulis suis obumbrábit tibi / Scuto circúmdabit te véritas eius' — 思高 v.4: '他以自己的羽毛掩护你，又叫你往他的翼下逃避：他的忠信是盾牌和铠衣'; antiphon excerpts taken verbatim from this. 6. Is 60:1-2 'Super te, Ierúsalem, oriétur Dóminus' — 思高 Is 60:2 '上主却照耀着你'; adapted for antiphon form. 7. Is 45:8 'Roráte cæli… Aperiátur terra et gérminet Salvatórem' — 思高 reads '愿大地裂开生出救恩'; breviary 'Salvatórem' (the Saviour, masc.) → '救主' instead of '救恩' to match the Vulgate's personification. 8. Ps 63(62):7 'In matutinis Dómine meditábor in te' — 思高 v.7: '当我在我床上想起了你时，我便彻夜不寐地默想着你'; antiphon focuses on 'matutinis' (morning); rendered as '清晨要默想着你'. 9. Ps 80(79):4 'Osténde fáciem tuam et salvi érimus' — 思高 Ps 80:4 '天主，求你使我们能以复兴，显示你的慈颜，好拯救我们'; abbreviated to 'Osténde fáciem tuam'. 10. Is 16:1 'Emítte Agnum Dómine dominatórem terræ de Petra desérti' — 思高 Is 16:1: '那地的主宰从旷野的磐石，应传达一言，至熙雍女儿的山岭'; breviary 'Emítte Agnum' (send the Lamb) renders as '请遣发那地的主宰，如同羔羊' combining Vulgate sense with 思高 vocabulary. 11. Ps 4:9 'In pace in idípsum dormiam et requiescam' — 思高 Ps 4:9: '在平安中我一躺下即刻入睡'; breviary adds 'requiescam' (and rest); translated faithfully. 12. 'Homo pacis meæ' (Ps 40:10) — 思高: '连我素来信赖的知心友好' (one who ate my bread); antiphon isolates first clause. 13. 'Qui scandis super sídera' — hymn fragment, 'You who ascend above the stars'; rendered '祢升越群星的'. 14. 'Qui corde fundis grátiam' — hymn fragment, 'You who pour forth grace from your heart'; rendered '祢从心中倾注恩宠的'.
